main_text.l: vsque ad Priscum Tarquinium. Origines [deinde] Ligu­
QVarro & quadragesimo volumine continentur res Hispanicæ & Punicæ.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a vase-like device with foliage and pendant tassels) stands below FINIS; no text. Several ink spots and stains on the page. The first line of the Prologus XLIII paragraph begins with a decorative initial T and the Prologus XLIV paragraph with a decorative initial Q; the first word of the Latin text "Tertio" and "Varrone" may be misread: the printed text reads "Ertio" and "Varto" as shown (the initials are missing letters). The Latin word "Massiliensium" is printed "Massilicusium" in the scan.
